section: Prologue: Gensokyo's Spring Snow and Gathering
description: Gensokyo is covered by endless spring snow. Each character notices the anomaly and heads to the Hakurei Shrine to gather. Reimu has already set off first. After getting acquainted, everyone decides to jointly investigate the mystery of the missing Spring Energy. Long'er attempts to use his ability to open a door but fails due to insufficient range.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Gensokyo is being eroded by a gentle disaster, an endless curtain of snow shrouds the heavens and earth. Branches that should be sprouting new buds are laden with icicles, and rivers have solidified into pale amber. The chimneys of the Human Village emit thin wisps of cooking smoke, snow has collapsed dilapidated shacks, and even the waterfall of Youkai Mountain has become a frozen sculpture. Eastern Gensokyo, Sunflower Field. This is one of the few places still retaining vitality. The golden sunflowers always face northeast, yearning for the nourishment of sunlight. But the sunlight is blocked by thick snow clouds. Among the sunflowers, a young girl is using large shears to deal with weeds. Beside her, a deformed monster follows, responsible for collecting the cut weeds. As if sensing something, the girl busy weeding looks up. A tall woman with green hair has appeared beside her at some point, holding a parasol for her. "What's wrong?" the girl asks. The woman pokes her cheek with a finger, frowning at the sky. "This snow... it's been falling for a while, hasn't it? Let's go ask that freeloading shrine maiden what she's doing." Hearing this, the girl nods, puts away the tools beside her, and then heads in the direction of Hakurei Shrine. Not far away at the same time, a place very close to the Sunflower Field. This was once a plain. For unknown reasons, since a few days ago, many lush cherry trees have grown here. Accompanying them is a lively fairy. She calls herself Lina. And now, Lina is very anxious. "What to do, what to do? It's clearly spring, but the heavy snow keeps falling nonstop. If this continues, the cherry trees will wither." Lina looks at the cherry trees with some heartache, and a bit fearfully towards the east. There's a very scary shrine maiden there. It's said she eats all fairies. But she also seems to moonlight as someone who resolves incidents. Should I go ask that scary shrine maiden for help? Lina struggles with this thought. Finally, gritting her teeth, she flutters her wings and sets off in the same direction as the gardening girl, seeking help simultaneously. Similar to the two girls, two men also have Hakurei Shrine as their destination. South of Hakurei Shrine, Bamboo Forest of the Lost. This is a forbidden zone for outsiders. Because of a certain Lunar Princess, the ever-growing bamboo here makes it nearly impossible for outsiders to find their way. But Long'er is not an outsider. Ever since being picked up and taken home by a certain carefree immortal, entering and exiting the bamboo forest has become routine for him. Like right now. "This inexplicable spring snow... Is this an incident?" At the entrance to the Bamboo Forest of the Lost, Long'er leans against an emerald bamboo, stretches out his hand. Snowflakes melt in his palm. Long'er closes his eyes. In his mind is the figure of a certain eccentric, elusive blonde-haired strange woman. "Let's consider it repaying a favor, to go ask what's going on. And maybe investigate clues about that woman while we're at it." Thinking this, Long'er looks towards the direction of Hakurei Shrine. And now, Hakurei Shrine. Long'er, Luoxueyu, and Lina arrive here almost simultaneously. Before them is a large torii. Hakurei Shrine is not far ahead. Although they don't know each other, they each have their own purposes.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Could they all be people looking for the shrine maiden, just like me?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: So everyone steps over the snow-covered torii. The stone steps of the sandō are covered in fresh snow, stone lanterns on both sides cast faint halos of light in the pale world. The water in the chozuya has frozen into an ice mirror, reflecting the lead-gray sky. When everyone finally steps onto the open area before the haiden, the vast shrine is silent except for the howling wind and snow. But contrasting with the lonely shrine's atmosphere is...

conversation.text: "So many people... I'm a bit scared..."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: In front of the Offering Box.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Is someone actually worshipping? I don't think I've heard the youkai mention it."

conversation.speaker: player1

conversation.speaker: player2

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: She also groped her way here. Arriving a step ahead of the others, Ge Qing is also just worshipping here. What she senses is that in the Living Quarters, there seems to be no one.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Is the head of the Hakurei household home?"

conversation.speaker: player4

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: No response.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Walks towards the woman who is worshipping.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "...Not here."

conversation.speaker: player1

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "What's that?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Not home?" #Heads towards the inner hall to look.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I, I have something to ask that shrine maiden!" #Shouts out as if having made a firm resolution.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The haiden where you are is shrouded in an eerie silence. The vermilion-lacquered wooden pillars form a stark contrast with the pale snow. To the right of the front plaza, there is a huge sacred tree now covered in icicles. Facing the tree, under the eaves of the residential area, it looks very cozy here. There is a cup of tea on the table. Ahead, there should be a door connecting to the bedroom. On the wall of the living area, there seems to be a map posted.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "I am not the shrine maiden of this place."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Eek!" #Hearing the loud shout nearby, immediately hides beside a pillar.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Long'er walks towards the living quarters.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Head of the Hakurei household, are you not home?" #Shouting.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: There is still no one here. The tea on the table is still lukewarm. The owner seems to have left not long ago.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I heard that on days like this, that shrine maiden would stay in her room to keep warm..."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "She has some matters to attend to. If you don't mind, you can tell me, and I'll relay the message for you."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "May I ask... who are you?" #Looks at the other person with slight confusion.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "The tea is still warm, but the person is gone. She must have just left." #Uses psychic power on the teacup! Connection of Life and Death!

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Who are you?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Just a pilgrim, with some acquaintance with the shrine maiden here."

conversation.text: The teacup on the table trembled slightly, then let out a long sigh, its tone exactly like that of a certain unscrupulous shrine maiden.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Hey, cup, can you tell me where the Hakurei head went?"

conversation.speaker: player1

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I, I want to ask that shrine maiden to end this disaster."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Just now, she was shouting about resolving the incident or something, drew a circle on the map, and hurried off in a rush."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Where is that map?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "I also want to find the shrine maiden to resolve the incident... otherwise, my grove will..."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "......, coincidentally, that should be the purpose of her trip."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Gently taps the rim of the cup with a finger.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Later... you're so annoying."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Won't bother you anymore." #Goes to the back to pick up Hakurei Reimu's map and see where she went.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Feels like this cup has a temper similar to that shrine maiden's rumored personality."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The map is pinned to the wall.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Speaking of which... are you all youkai?" #Looking at the others, trembling.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Bows three times to the cup. "Shouldn't be disrespectful to the shrine maiden's belongings."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Indeed, she is truly lazy by nature."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: On the old wooden wall, a hand-drawn map of Gensokyo is firmly fixed with three talisman nails. The map shows frayed edges under the flickering candlelight, and the talisman nail pinning the location of the Terakoya is seeping faint red ink like spiderwebs, slowly staining the wooden wall panel below. conversation.text: #recalling the flowers in the field, can't help but sigh

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: You descend the last stone step of the shrine and stop at a fork in the road. The mountain path you came from on the left is covered by fresh snow, leaving only a faint outline. The Birch Forest on the right stands silently within the curtain of snow, each branch wrapped in a transparent coat of ice.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Such heavy snow..."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: There are many trees in the Birch Forest, and pink light points occasionally drift out, but the withering speed isn't as fast.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Who knows. Right now, finding the Hakurei head is most important."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I know the way better! Maybe I can help."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Infinite, boundless illusion." Long'er gazes at the snowflakes falling all over the sky, softly recites his Spell Card. The surrounding snowflakes begin to gather and condense before him, forming a gate made of snowflakes that looks as if it would scatter with a single blow.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The snow door before Long'er trembled violently the moment it took shape, with countless snowflakes intricately weaving into an arched doorframe. Inside, swirling light and shadow faintly revealed the eaves of the Terakoya. But the next second, the entire structure suddenly collapsed and scattered—what appeared behind the door was still that birch forest hung with icicles, only now the location was dozens of meters deeper into the woods. On the snow-covered ground, a few pink light points that had come against the wind remained.
